Container.Name: Stoat-Chat-Stack
Container.Overview:
Stoat (formerly Revolt) is a self-hosted, open-source chat platform - a privacy-focused alternative to Discord.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is a DOCKER COMPOSE application requiring multiple containers.
📋 INSTALLATION STEPS: 1. Install "Docker Compose Manager" from Community Apps 2. SSH into your Unraid server 3. Run these commands:
mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/stoat cd /mnt/user/appdata/stoat git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid.git . chmod +x setup-unraid.sh ./setup-unraid.sh YOUR.DOMAIN.COM
4. In Unraid GUI: Docker → Compose → Add Stack → Point to /mnt/user/appdata/stoat
✨ FEATURES: • Real-time messaging with WebSocket support • File uploads and attachments • Image and link previews • GIF search via Tenor • Push notifications • Full API access
📋 REQUIREMENTS: • Domain name with DNS pointing to your server • Ports 80/443 available (or configure behind reverse proxy) • 2GB+ RAM recommended • Docker Compose Manager plugin
📖 Full documentation: https://github.com/revoltchat/self-hosted/tree/master/unraid
Container.Requires: Docker Compose Manager plugin is REQUIRED for this multi-container application. Install from Community Apps before proceeding.
